behavior: An open `Collapsible.Trigger` or `Accordion.Trigger` names in `aria-controls` only a panel that is registered now, and an `Accordion.Panel` names in `aria-labelledby` only a trigger that is registered now. The three parts defer their server render, so the server HTML names the `id` prop of a panel or of a trigger, in each order of the two parts. With no such part, the attribute is absent. Base UI names a generated id until the first panel or trigger mounts. No element has that id in the server HTML of a part with an `id` prop, and in a root or an item that has no such part.
